title: docs/derived/state/requirements.json — the approved denominator
description: AUTHORED by the project, never written by this pack. additionalProperties is TRUE throughout: the founder owns this file and may carry fields the kernel does not read. ⛔ Note what the kernel does NOT validate — `schemaVersion` is present by convention and is consumed only through the freshness manifest; kernel/lib/state.js never checks it. Declaring that here is the point: the gap is stated rather than implied away.

mandatory.description: Absent means mandatory. Only an explicit `false` opts out — a typo must not silently shrink the denominator.
